name: 97141 · Tillamook, OR
findings: ZIP 97141 (Tillamook) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97141 (Tillamook) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97141 (Tillamook) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
